items.title: Earl May interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2001
items.q: And Red Garland called halfway through the date and said that his car broke down so he wouldn’t make the date, so we wound up doing the whole thing as a trio

ctx.x: He’d ask me, “You know this tune?” And he said, “Well we’re going to do like, I want you to play this kind of an intro” [scats]. He would just tell me what he wanted and I would do my best. But I was so scared. I was so scared. That date, the takes that came out, not very favorable in my direction because Arthur Taylor was way — like almost in the other room. We did it at Rudy VanGelder’s, in his living room at that time you know. And he really separated us. So I didn’t really lock up with the drummer like I…
